start_here: Say to your AI: "Offer or change a place I host, in my own database", with the database and person it needs.
no_lists_because: It keeps its stays in the person's own database table, named by the database given; it names no list of yours.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Offer or change a place I host, in my own database", and give it database (the person's own pursuit database, such as ethos_for_who_runs_it) and person.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:save-a-stay and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: it answers the stay as kept, with its stay_id, title, where, price and active flag. Refused when the stay is not the person's.
